notes: Run each prompt with and without the skill in a fresh agent and a scratch dir. Objective checks run through scripts/validate.mjs + inspect.mjs; 'judged' items are a pairwise look at the geo/anim sheets vs the no-skill baseline.

evals.prompt: Make wheelbarrow.glb for a three.js farm game: about 1.4 m long, one front wheel that can spin, two handles at the back, a tray, and an attachment point where the load sits. Add a looping Roll clip that turns the wheel.
assert: a node whose name contains 'wheel' has its origin at the wheel axle (inspect: world y ~= wheel radius)
Roll is a loop clip with LOOP_SEAM absent and the wheel track not STATIC
evals.judged: Reads as a wheelbarrow; front (wheel) faces +Z

evals.prompt: Make a dog (dog.glb), ~0.9 m long, with Idle (tail wags, head tilts) and Walk (looping walk cycle) clips and an attachment point on the collar.
assert: clips Idle and Walk exist; Walk loops
a socket exists under the head/neck chain
evals.judged: Walk filmstrip shows alternating legs; dog faces +Z

evals.prompt: Make a snake (snake.glb), ~2 m long when straight, as one skinned mesh with at least 5 bones and a looping Slither clip where the body waves side to side.
assert: exactly one skinned mesh at scene root
evals.judged: Body visibly bends in an S curve across frames

evals.prompt: Make crate.glb, a 1 m wooden crate with a plank texture (generated, not a flat colour) and a darker frame around each face.
evals.judged: Plank pattern visible, not black or stretched

evals.prompt: This GLB (evals/files/broken.glb, spec evals/files/broken.spec.json) loads wrong in our game. Find everything wrong with it and fix it.
assert: reports dotted names, non-root skinned mesh, weights summing to 0.8, zero-weight joints, missing normals, inside-out crate, missing Socket_Hat
fixed file passes validate with the spec

evals.prompt: Make the wheels of the wheelbarrow from the first eval 20% bigger and keep it sitting on the ground.
assert: only wheel parts and things positioned from the wheel radius changed (inspect diff)

trigger_negatives: load a Kenney GLB into the scene and add a collider
make a 2D sprite sheet for the chicken
write a shader for grass sway
